question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**through**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**through**'.
 
• The sentence is talking about the magistrate walking from one end of the market to the other.
 
• It means **'from one end or side of something to the other'.** (किसी चीज के एक सिरे या किनारे से दूसरे छोर तक)
 
 
• *Example: They walked slowly **through** the woods.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *"One day while the magistrate was walking **through** a market..."*
